VBO:0200314.summary: Affectionate and friendly, the Cavamalt often seeks human company and alternates lively play with long rests at home. This Maltese–Cavalier cross can enjoy a quick game of fetch, while some young dogs struggle to hold their attention through lengthy lessons. An alert bark may greet unfamiliar visitors. Individuals differ in coat texture and colour.
VBO:0200314.shortDescription: Cavamalts often seek company, enjoy brief games of fetch and settle into long rests, with a friendly, affectionate manner.
